concerns.text: Task T012a (fetch ChEMBL) and T012b (parse SMILES) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on T004 (Setup data_loader). T004 is in Phase 2. While Phase 2 precedes Phase 3, T012a and T012b share the same file `code/ingestion.py`. Marking them [P] implies they can run in parallel, but writing to the same file simultaneously causes race conditions. They must be sequential or split into distinct file outputs.

Task T013 (handle duplicates) depends on T012c (graph construction) and T012d (descriptors) producing `data/processed/graphs.csv` and `data/processed/descriptors.json`. However, T013 is marked [P] alongside T012c/d. T013 cannot run in parallel with T012c/d as it consumes their output artifacts. The [P] tag is incorrect here.

Task T015 (timeout enforcement) and T016 (logging) are marked [P] but logically depend on the implementation of T012a-d to have logic to wrap or log. While they could be written in parallel, they cannot be *executed* or *tested* in parallel with the core logic they modify. More critically, T015 references '2-core, 7GB RAM runner' which is defined in US-1, but the task itself is a modification of `code/ingestion.py` which is being built in T012a-d. The [P] tag suggests independence that doesn't exist for execution.

Task T020a (scaffold splitting) and T020b (CV loop) are marked [P] but T020b orchestrates T020a. T020b cannot run before T020a is implemented. Furthermore, T020a depends on the data produced by US1 (T012c/d). The [P] tag is misleading for tasks that are strictly sequential within the same file `code/training.py`.

Task T024 (statistical test) depends on T022 (metric aggregation) which produces `data/processed/predictions.csv`. T024 is marked [P] but cannot execute until T022 completes. The [P] tag is invalid for a consumer of T022's artifact.

Task T031 (permutation importance) and T032 (perturbation) depend on the trained GNN model from US2 (T020c). T031 is marked [P] but cannot run until the model artifact exists. The [P] tag is incorrect as it implies independence from the US2 completion.
Task T033 (generate report) depends on T030 (sensitivity results) and T032 (perturbation results). T033 is marked [P] but is a consumer of T030 and T032. It cannot run in parallel with them.
